Page: Cure Light Wounds.text: Cure Light Wounds (Level 1). To cast, mix 2 Charcoal + 1 Sulfur + 2 Dried Sage + 1 Silver Dust. When the mixture settles, knits flesh and closes wounds.

Page: Detect Magic.text: Detect Magic (Level 1). To cast, mix 1 Charcoal + 1 Dried Sage. When the mixture settles, lays bare the auras around you.

Page: Light.text: Light (Level 1). To cast, mix 1 Charcoal + 1 Silver Dust. When the mixture settles, kindles a steady, quiet glow that costs nothing to hold.
